name: pilot-light
description: Band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown, context size, 5h/7d limits, API-equivalent cost, cost of a cold next message, silent keep-alive pings under a dollar cap, and a Handoff & Clear button.

cacheWindowMinutes.title: Cache window (minutes)
cacheWindowMinutes.description: Prompt-cache lifetime in minutes, used until the real one (5m or 1h) is detected from API usage.

keepAlive.title: Keep-alive pings
keepAlive.description: While you are away, re-read the cached conversation shortly before it expires. Pings stop once they have cost as much as one cold re-send would, and start again when you next prompt.
